notes.title: Nudist Beach Survival Simulator Remastered is available now!
notes.content:
More than three years after its release date, Nudist Beach Survival Simulator has received a [b]remastered version![/b]

New [b]game modes[/b], [b]controller support[/b] and [b]achievements[/b] are just some of the new features in this game. 

Enriched with an [b]arcade mode[/b], it should keep you hooked for longer than the original.

What's more, you can still play the original version. Just fire up the game directly from your library and select "Nudist Beach Survival Simulator (2017)". However, the achievements for the old version [b]are no longer available[/b]. 

I hope that what I have prepared for you will appeal to you. Enjoy the game ~ [b]Dev, Tornado Games[/b].

[url=https://discord.gg/3TS353EEBE]JOIN DISCORD[/url] to keep being informed.

notes.title: Nudist Beach Survival Simulator Remastered is on the way!
notes.content:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/708640/Nudist_Beach_Survival_Simulator/?curator_clanid=33872549]Nudist Beach Survival Simulator[/url][/b] will be re-created on Unreal Engine 4! Changing the engine is primarily to fix all minor bugs in the game and add new content.

By default, the new version of the game will be included:
[list]
[*] New gameplay modes
[*] More settings 
[*] Full controller support
[*] New Steam achievements
[*] Steam Cloud support
[/list]

Expected premiere date: [b]fourth quarter 2020[/b]

Stay tuned!
